faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Vogue use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation and year. The Range Rover Vogue (L322, 2001–2012, and L405, 2012–2021) was available with the TDV6 or SDV6 3.0-litre V6 diesel, or the TDV8 or SDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Vogue engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400 for six-cylinder engines, and from £4,500 for V8 engines. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Vogue?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have a TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 or SDV8 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover Vogue engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover Vogue engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The SDV6 shares the same engine family and wear pattern as the TDV6, and we service it to the same standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV8 Range Rover Vogue engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The TDV8 V8 diesel shares the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as the six-cylinder engines, and we replace these components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover Vogue engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The SDV8 is the higher-output V8 in the same family, and we service it to the same standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Vogue engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Vogue if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Vogue engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Vogue owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
